protocol.name: mmmu_validation_single_image_mc_256_letterbox_strict_letter_v1
protocol.image_method: EXIF transpose; composite transparency on white; aspect-preserving LANCZOS fit; centered white RGB256 canvas; JPEG quality100/subsampling0
protocol.prompt_method: One image then question and A.-labelled choices; sole-image reference markers become [Image]; exact uppercase letter instruction; no thinking
protocol.score_method: Strip surrounding whitespace; accept exactly one valid uppercase option letter. Any other complete response is unparseable and incorrect. Never guess/randomize/drop failures.
protocol.engine_request_adapters: Add only installed-engine token-ID return flags to canonical semantic requests, retaining both wire hashes. Model alias may change only for declared INT4/4B comparisons.
protocol.required_runtime_checks: Actual prompt IDs,64image tokens/grid, prompt+completion<=4096, same checkpoint/semantic payload and complete output records; exact preprocessing equality is not established by CPU preparation.
